mapper.sql: SELECT id, instance_id, node_id, node_name, assignee, status, create_time, complete_time FROM wf_task
mapper.select: SELECT t.*, p.business_table, p.business_key, p.business_id, p.applicant FROM wf_task t JOIN wf_process_instance p ON t.instance_id = p.id WHERE t.assignee = #{assignee} AND t.status = 'pending' ORDER BY t.create_time DESC

SELECT t.*, p.business_table, p.business_key, p.business_id, p.applicant FROM wf_task t JOIN wf_process_instance p ON t.instance_id = p.id WHERE p.business_key = #{businessKey} AND t.node_id = #{nodeId} AND t.status = 'pending'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wf_task WHERE instance_id = #{instanceId} AND node_id = #{nodeId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wf_task WHERE instance_id = #{instanceId} AND node_id = #{nodeId} AND status = #{status}
SELECT t.* FROM wf_task t JOIN wf_node_definition n ON t.node_id = n.node_id AND t.status = 'pending' WHERE n.timeout_hours > 0 AND DATE_ADD(t.create_time, INTERVAL n.timeout_hours HOUR) < NOW()
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wf_task(instance_id, node_id, node_name, assignee, status, create_time) VALUES (#{instanceId}, #{nodeId}, #{nodeName}, #{assignee}, 'pending', SYSDATE())
mapper.update: UPDATE wf_task SET status = #{status}, complete_time = #{completeTime} WHERE id = #{id}
